_comment: Weights for scripts/parity-score.py. Each key is an Area exactly as written in the area column of docs/parity-status.md. A parity id counts with its area weight; an id cited in the 'Next 25 gaps for daily residential work' table has its weight multiplied by next25_bonus. Weight 3 = daily residential work comes first (the doc's own ordering), 2 = frequent, 1 = occasional. An area in the doc with no entry here gets weight 1 and a warning.
